# Matthew Park

> Matthew Park is a 15-year-old builder and creator from Kentucky (Korean-American). This site is his portfolio: every dated moment of his life in order, the things he has built, and what he plans next.

## Highlights
- Founder of Axiom, a nonprofit using AI to help high schoolers land internships (550+ interns, 10+ startups).
- Former CMO / cofounder of Prayer Lock: took it from $2K MRR to $14K (7×).
- Creator with 30M+ views across platforms; worked with Turbolearn AI and MathGPT.
- Stanford ASES Launchpad, YC Startup School, a $10,000 Google grant.
- National Sustainable Development Award and 1st in ESGD at LRSEF; state qualifier in Speech & Debate.
- KMEA All-State alto sax (2nd chair, twice); tennis, basketball, drums, guitar, singing.
